verdict.rationale: Whether a document-AI service publishes its source under an open license is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a hosted API, official SDK clients and on-prem/single-container enterprise deployment. None of it states that the product's source code or model weights are available under an open license. Self-hosted deployment and SDKs are adjacent features and do not establish open-source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
